spanish: Porque todo comiente grasa desde la bestia que acercará desde ella ofrenda de fuego a Jehová, y será cortada el alma la comiente desde sus pueblos.

findings.issue: Hiphil imperfect is 3rd masculine singular with an unstated masculine subject; the feminine beast is only the source marked by the 3fs suffix. “la bestia que acercará” makes the beast the one who brings the offering.

notes: Remaining tokens, including feminine niphal cut-off, feminine participle, plural peoples, and Jehová, match the packet.
